description: Volumes et durées des déversements, travaux intercepteur sud-est, Nov. 2015 (archives) is a dataset listed in City of Montréal open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Ville de Montréal. Durant le mois de novembre 2015, La Ville de Montréal a réalisé des travaux majeurs d'entretien de l'intercepteur sud-est qui ont requis la mise en chômage de celui-ci. Il en a résulté un déversement d'eaux usées dont la durée et le volume ont été estimés. Coverage: Montréal. The portal files it under the publisher Ville de Montréal. Its tags are Déversement, Eau, Fleuve, Fleuve Saint-Laurent, Intercepteur. It offers 3 resource(s) in CSV, XLSX. The portal shows 2025-02-26 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-montreal-portal.
